save over dir named .md: Both answer 500 with an OS-level error text: Go reports `renameat <tmp> isdir.md: file exists`, the Rust server `renameat isdir.md: is a directory` (the errno differs and Go names the temporary file).
range 'bytes=0-5,10-15': Several ranges in one Range header: Go answers 206 multipart/byteranges; the Rust server ignores the Range and answers 200 with the whole file (allowed by RFC 9110). The frontend and PDF.js only ever send a single range.
static /assets/: A request for an embedded directory: Go's http.FileServer returns an HTML directory listing, the Rust server returns the SPA index.html. Not used by the app.
raw very long uri: A 70 KB request target: Go routes it and answers 500 (ENAMETOOLONG from the file system), hyper refuses it earlier with 414 (URI too long).
